strings.unesco.title: Al-Ahsa Oasis on the World Heritage List
strings.unesco.lead: Al-Ahsa Oasis was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2018 (site 1563). The site comprises twelve components; {comps.length} of them are landmarks with their own pages in this guide, listed here in the order of their component numbers on the official list.
strings.unesco.official: The full list of the twelve components and their maps is on the site’s page at the UNESCO World Heritage Centre.
strings.unesco.seoDesc: {comps.length} of the twelve components of the Al-Ahsa Oasis UNESCO World Heritage site (2018) with their own pages: {names}.
strings.report.title: Report an error
strings.report.lead: Accuracy is what we care about most. If you spot an inaccurate detail, a broken link or a misplaced photo, tell us and we will review it.
strings.report.msgPh: Describe the error briefly — and if you know the correct information and its source, add it.
strings.report.emailL: Your email (optional — if you would like a reply)
strings.report.note: Your report goes straight to the site team; none of it is published.
strings.thanks.title: Your report has arrived — thank you
strings.thanks.d: The site team will review the note and correct whatever is confirmed. Your contribution keeps the Al-Ahsa guide accurate for everyone.
strings.ui.tmap.title: Terrain Map
strings.ui.tmap.lead: The oasis in relief: Jabal Al-Qarah, the palm groves, and the dunes to the east — with every attraction in place. Click or tap any name in the list to see it on the map.
strings.ui.tmap.list.title: All attractions on the map
strings.ui.tmap.gest.win: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
strings.ui.tmap.gest.mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
strings.ui.tmap.gest.touch: Use two fingers to move the map
